title: Reset Block Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 128bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
They are driving the ball
Dont swing back
Absorb the pace
Reset the rally

[Whisper verse]
Feet still no step back
Knees bend low absorb
Paddle out front waist height
Grip pressure two out of ten

Contact in front of the chest
Paddle face open thirty five
No backswing at all
Let the ball hit the face

[Tribal drop chant]
Reset the ball reset the ball
Soft and slow soft and slow
Suave suave pa lante
Reset the ball reset the ball

[Whisper verse]
Deflect like a cushion
Landing zone the kitchen
Apex above the tape
Take the speed off

No follow through needed
Return to ready slow
Stay tall stay calm
Breath out and reset eyes

[Tribal drop chant]
Reset the ball reset the ball
Soft and slow soft and slow
Suave suave pa lante
Reset the ball reset the ball

[Whisper outro]
Absorb
Reset
Absorb
Reset
